Offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, so the 5-day limit doesn't apply to your January 28 offer. Seven days from January 28 is February 4, and we honor the offer if your appraisal appointment is on or before the expiration date, as long as you haven't driven more than 300 additional miles. Please check the exact expiration date on your offer page or in your confirmation email, and note that rescheduling to a later date won't extend it.
